name: Cleo Cuida Peludos

short_description: Family dog boarding and daycare for dogs up to 15 kg with daily walks and photo updates.

description: Cleo Cuida Peludos provides home dog boarding and daytime care in Rascanya for small and medium dogs up to 15 kg. Operating in a quiet home environment, the facility hosts up to 3 dogs at a time with a minimum of 3 outdoor walks each day. Pet owners receive daily photo and video updates, with pre-stay visits arranged before booking.
description_local: Cleo Cuida Peludos ofrece alojamiento canino y guardería de día en Rascanya para perros pequeños y medianos de hasta 15 kg. En un entorno familiar y tranquilo, atiende hasta 3 perros al mismo tiempo con un mínimo de 3 paseos al aire libre cada día. Las familias reciben fotos y vídeos a diario, y disponen de visita previa antes de reservar.

description: Residencia Canina Devesa Gardens (Devesalia) provides dog and cat boarding in Pobles del Sud, situated inside the Devesa Gardens complex in the Albufera nature reserve. The facility contains individual indoor accommodation boxes for dogs and cats alongside designated outdoor areas for walks and exercise. Animal care staff look after the pets during their stay.
